description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU, and environment variables within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for external functions, metadata, and macros for module identification.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Class providing system information such as memory, CPU, environment variables, and system identifiers, with singleton access and nested MemorySnapshot class for memory state.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value by name.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets environment variable value by name, with forced option.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides singleton instance of SystemInfo (Windows and non-Windows implementations).

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of physical pages.

methods.name: GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory usage.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Serializes memory snapshot to JSON string.
